_doc: Garment proxy slots. z and loose_below_z are fractions of bare body height (feet 0, head top 1); margin is the square frame multiplier. clearance_cm is minimum radial and crown clearance (0-10 cm); loose_clearance_cm is shoulder/cape clearance (clearance_cm-15 cm) below loose_below_z, blended into clearance_cm over 10% of body height. Values take effect when depth PNGs are rendered and copied into the Forge. Null z slots are unavailable. Proxy geometry and fit rules are versioned code, not console expressions.
